root_cause: Timeout for payment-gateway calls cut from 4 s to 400 ms; slow authorisations were abandoned mid-flight, so some shoppers were charged with no order created
Retry count raised from 1 to 5 in prod only (staging still had 1); retries turned a payment-gateway slowdown into a retry storm
Gift-card flag went to 100% before the canary finished; gift-card balances could be spent twice for 20 minutes
TLS library major upgrade dropped a cipher suite the card processor still required; every authorisation failed until rollback
Fraud-score threshold edited by hand in one region; that region's config drifted from the others and card declines rose fourfold there
Card-processor traffic moved behind a new NAT gateway; the processor had not allow-listed the new IP addresses and refused 30% of calls
Index build on the orders table ran without the online option and locked writes for 6 minutes at peak
Split-shipment flag enabled in every region at once; fulfilment received duplicate requests for 3% of orders
Column renamed while order-service still read the old name; stock lookups from order-service failed for 15 minutes
JSON library upgrade changed how decimals were serialised; stock counts arrived as strings and a caller rejected them
Email workers moved to spot instances; a mass preemption paused sending for 50 minutes with no alert
UI framework upgrade changed form-submit handling; on slow networks the pay button submitted orders twice
CDN rule change cached a signed-in page, so shoppers briefly saw another shopper's first name in the cart header
Flag turned on for app versions that did not contain the new code path; older versions showed a blank checkout screen
Session store moved to a new cluster without copying live sessions; most signed-in shoppers were logged out mid-checkout
Clock-skew tolerance for token validation cut to zero; tokens from hosts with small clock drift were rejected
